prompt:
A wide 16:9 flat studio sheet showing exactly two separate old clock hands lying side by side, horizontal, pointing right, as a dark storybook illustration. Text-free, with no frame or watermark.

Top: one long minute hand, about 80 percent of the canvas width and thin, in dark ash-blue iron (#3d4650 to #535d68): a round pivot ring at its left end, a slender shaft with one small open loop near the middle, and a narrow spade tip at the right. Bottom: one short hour hand, about 55 percent of the canvas width and a little thicker, same metal: round pivot ring at the left end, a shaft with a small pierced heart-shaped opening, and a broad spade tip. Both hands are lit flat and dim with a faint cool edge along their top side; the metal is slightly warped as if softened by heat. The two hands do not touch and sit well apart vertically.

The background is one flat digital pure magenta (#FF00FF) that fills every area the hands do not cover, edge to edge, like a magenta-screen backdrop: one unchanging magenta with no light, no shadow, no paper grain, no hatching and no texture; the grain and hatching apply to the hands only. The hands use only ash-blue greys, slate and near-black, never pink-tinted; every edge is crisp against the magenta with a thin dark ink outline. Colours are given only as guidance; never print them.

Style (required): dark, muted ink on aged paper, like an etched storybook engraving. Etched ink linework with near-black ink outlines; crosshatch and fine line hatching for every shadow and form; visible aged paper grain and fibre texture under all colour; hand-printed, slightly uneven ink. No flat fills, no vector shapes, no smooth digital gradients, no glossy 3D rendering.
